name: expo-56
description: Authoritative, version-pinned offline reference for Expo SDK 56 and SDK 57. One skill, 21 bundled API references, covering both building on either release and the 55→56 / 56→57 migrations. SDK 57 is current (57.0.8, RN 0.86); SDK 56 is the previous supported release (56.0.17, RN 0.85). Audited against expo/expo source 2026-07-25.
